meta.name: V4 Full Implementation Plan
meta.objective: Compile a full deep-workflow implementation plan for judge-gym V4 as a greenfield rebuild that lands Media Cloud-centered acquisition, the V4 evidence substrate, prompt/config generalization, provider/runtime abstraction, observability, testing, and the actual V4 experiment setup, with Media Cloud API verification gated on a user-provided key.

compile.baseHint: Treat prior V4 research as architecture input, but compile this workflow under greenfield assumptions: compatibility shims are unnecessary, the full target architecture should be built in dependency order, and the actual V4 experiment remains the final epic. The only external dependency gate is a user-provided Media Cloud key for live verification.
taskSignals: User explicitly requested a full implementation workflow plan.
The project is greenfield and sweeping changes are allowed.
Implementation should cover acquisition, schema, runtime, prompts, providers, observability, tests, and experiment setup.
The user explicitly instructed that development starts with an agent-owned `bun dev` session.
The only required user input should be the Media Cloud key before live API verification.
notes: This artifact is compile-only in the current turn and is meant to be the execution contract for the future buildout.
Observability and tests are first-class deliverables and should be implemented alongside feature epics.
Media Cloud replaces Firecrawl as the discovery layer, but the acquisition system remains split into discovery and hydration.
Do not begin the actual V4 experiment until the platform epics have passed their validation gates.

stopConditions: Stop after compilation in this turn because the user asked for the workflow plan, not immediate implementation.
When execution begins, stop before live Media Cloud verification until the user supplies the key.
Do not start the real V4 experiment until acquisition, schema, runtime, observability, and test epics are green.
approvalRequired: Media Cloud API key before live discovery verification and end-to-end acquisition tests.

budget.testDiscipline: Every implementation ticket must define unit, integration, and smoke validation before patching begins.
budget.observabilityDiscipline: Every new runtime surface must emit traceable process artifacts and debug hooks.
